checkpoints.name: Add most_common(text, n) helper
checkpoints.scope: Add a most_common(text, n) function to src/word_stats.py that returns the n most frequent words as (word, count) tuples, ordered by count descending then alphabetically for ties. Reuse word_counts(). Add unit tests in tests/test_word_stats.py.
exit_criteria: most_common("the cat sat on the mat the cat ran", 2) == [("the", 3), ("cat", 2)]

checkpoints.name: Wire --top N CLI flag
checkpoints.scope: Add an optional --top N argument to word_stats.py's CLI. When passed, print only the top N words via most_common(), most-frequent first, same 'word: count' format. Behavior with no --top flag must be unchanged.
exit_criteria: python3 src/word_stats.py <file> --top 2 prints exactly 2 lines, most-frequent word first
